coordinateSystem: Top-left origin; integer hull C logical pixels; nearest-neighbour display; paths relative to this manifest

palette.source: All 48 opaque RGB values from shipped deck.png
palette.scope: Runtime assets tall-mast.png and mast-occluder.png; unnormalized source is provenance only

crowsNest.description: Wooden elliptical basket, dark interior and navy lower hoop; pole continues above it

riggingAttachmentPoints.description: Small generated side lugs below basket; ropes supplied by integration

trim.clearRowsDefinition: Rows strictly below basket bottom and above yard pivot: hull y=-35..-13 inclusive; small retained lugs occupy part of this interval.

sail.description: Current tall sail: two 114x84 frames, unchanged at hull [154,-15]. Yard pivot remains hull [211,-12], 122px above deck baseline 110. Only its coordinate within the shorter mast texture changes, from [24,100] to [24,68]. No sail or yard baked into mast.
sail.manifestHashNormalization: UTF-8 with LF line endings, matching repository blob; Windows checkout may use CRLF.

occluder.description: Exact original lower mast depth overlay. Upper mast is behind crew and new sail; original lower piece still covers crew crossing behind mast.

drawOrder: Trimmed mast at [187,-80] behind sail and crew
Existing depth-sorted crew and lower mast occluder at [202,48], baseline 110
integration.bounds: Tip is hull y=-78; bottom remains y111. Existing negative-y scene space is sufficient.
integration.warning: Assets-only handoff. extras.json still has the previous mast size [48,224] and position [187,-112]. Apply metadataToApply when integrating; do not merely replace the PNG under the old origin. Sail placement, deck anchor, occluder and crew scale remain unchanged. Reattach any nest-based rigging to the lowered nest.
integration.previewDescription: 2x static fit: current tall mast left, trimmed mast right. Both use the current 114x84 rest sail, same hull and same crew. Transparent background. Existing reference fitting study omits long rigging.
integration.candidateOrder: 1..8 left to right; normalized candidates share locked old nest and lower shaft; only generated join differs.

inheritedArt.description: Original built-in generated mast provenance retained unchanged.

normalization.implementation: C# System.Drawing; mechanical cropping, block sampling, palette normalization and preserved-region compositing only; no procedural drawing.
normalization.method: For each destination pixel, use floor-bounded source block. Require at least half its pixels to have alpha >=128. Take median opaque RGB per channel, then nearest squared-RGB match to the exact 48-colour deck palette. Output alpha 255; all outside-silhouette pixels alpha 0. No dithering.
normalization.preservedTop: Copy previous mast rows 0..48 to new rows 0..48, all 48 columns, without pixel changes. This retains the masthead, entire nest and lugs and lowers them 32 hull pixels through the new origin.
normalization.preservedLower: Copy previous rows 100..223 to new rows 68..191, all 48 columns, without pixel changes. These are identical hull positions from yard y=-12 down through foot y111.
normalization.extent: Only the shortened 9x19 pole join is sampled from candidate 6. Generated candidate nest and foot are intentionally unused to preserve the exact shipped art.
normalization.scale: One logical pixel per hull pixel; nearest-neighbour display; unchanged 9px shaft and 19px foot.

limitations: Static native-scale and 2x fitting study verified; no runtime installation or motion/rigging test was performed.
Generated join has restrained grain changes visible at large zoom. Existing nest and yard-to-foot pixels are exact.
Integration must update mast size and origin from integration.metadataToApply; no runtime wiring changed in this assets-only branch.
